name: Ultimate Metro
summary: Tram-based metro termini and a through station with a pedestrian underpass.
description: Ultimate Metro 0.9.1 adds a prototype Metro Through Station: two 80m side platforms, ordinary electric tramtrack connections at both ends, two street-side pedestrian entrances and native rail-station stair assets for a pedestrian underpass. Through lanes use ordinary directional tram modes without reservation flags. The underpass paths and terrain holes are adapted from native modern railway platforms; no extra train infrastructure is required. Existing terminus resource IDs and layouts are retained. Shared surface decoration prepares the station family for future configuration; selectable lengths, types and platform counts are not implemented yet. New station placement, routing, pedestrian stairs, boarding and persistence require in-game validation. Speed investigation remains separate. Do not remove the mod while its stations remain. Station lane limits now use direct values 80/40 instead of dividing them by 3.6, following native station examples and the reported 23 km/h straight-line behavior. Street-template speeds retain their separate conversion. The effective speed after this correction requires in-game confirmation.
